entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Ancient Fomori-made golden sphere vault on Thunder Junction, rumored to hide untold riches, hidden inside a rock formation.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: Town the Hellspurs built around the Vault.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Dragon leader of the Hellspurs, sealed inside the Vault.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: Sterling Company member who collected keys to the vault.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Leader of a gang who stole the key and opened the vault.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker disguised as Ashiok who hired Oko's gang and took the infant from the vault.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Warlock who judged the key to be very old.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: Infant creature in stasis at the vault's center.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Planar passages whose opening drew parties to the Vault.

events.quote: Maag Taranau was created by the Fomori

events.summary: After the Omenpaths open, parties race for the Vault; Akul builds Tarnation, and Graywater collects keys.
events.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built Tarnation around the vault hoping to control it.

events.summary: Oko's gang, hired by Jace as Ashiok, steals the sixth key.
events.quote: The key was later stolen by Oko 's gang

events.summary: Akul takes the key from the gang and fits it to his medallion, revealing six pieces of one key; Oko steals it back.
events.quote: Oko stole this final key back during a shootout

events.summary: Oko opens the vault and Jace takes the infant and planeswalks, triggering a trap that sends the vault into space with Akul sealed inside.

relations.quote: Maag Taranau was created by the Fomori
When the gang ran afoul of the Hellspurs, the key was taken by Akul.

relations.note: hired by Jace disguised as Ashiok
relations.quote: who were hired by the planeswalker Jace Beleren
